(1) Questionnaire.docx (sha256 82891eef...) statement table prints C1..C4 each beside its item under "F STUDENT CHOICE"; shipped item_text equals the text printed against its code 4/4 verbatim. (2) Live table (5956 rows, 1489 ids) vs deposit xlsx (1489 rows): live resp for each (id, Ck) equals xlsx row id, column Ck in 100% of cells for all 4 items; agreement with any other C column is 0.40-0.49 (best 0.490), so no two items can be swapped undetected. Every item is distinguished from every other. The xlsx composite column C (r=0.255 with mean(C1..C4)) is not used. Not established: that the depositor filled xlsx column Ck from questionnaire item Ck (the depositor own code labelling, taken as authoritative; no article with per-item statistics exists), nor the anchor direction, which rests on the questionnaire 1 = Strongly disagree -> 5 = Strongly agree line (possible block reversal unproven, see notes).
